credit_line: Gift of The Burnett Foundation and The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Painting of  black shiny rock seated on a stump against a red background.  Tonal variations in the rock give it volume and a smooth texture that pick up the red surrounding it, and a strong light source hitting it in the center, and resulting in the shadow beneath on the stump.
